lessons.correction: Continue developing economy and production, maintain a moderate ground army, and start teching up. Keep defense light but be ready to react to pressure.
lessons.mistake: Focusing solely on economy and neglecting army production, leaving you vulnerable to a sudden attack.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have a few tech structures started and economy is still strong. If opponent goes air, prepare anti-air.
lessons.title: Balance economy and tech with defense
lessons.when: Early-midgame, both players are on ground with moderate production and tech, and you have a strong economy.
lessons.why: Teching early keeps you ahead, while a moderate army deters attacks and allows safe tech investment.

lessons.correction: Strengthen your ground army to match the opponent's composition, continue developing economy and production, and consider increasing technology for better units.
lessons.mistake: Over-investing in a single unit composition without scouting, risking a surprise switch to air or different ground.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when your army is comparable and economy is good. If opponent transitions to air, add anti-air or switch to air.
lessons.title: Match opponent's heavy ground with tech and economy
lessons.when: Midgame, opponent has heavy ground (Zergling, Roach, Queen) with heavy production and tech; you have moderate ground (Zergling, Hydralisk, Queen) and moderate tech.
lessons.why: A strong ground army defends and counters, while economy sustains it. Hydralisks counter Roaches, Zerglings provide mobility.

lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army, maintain heavy production, and consider increasing technology to get Roaches or Hydralisks. Keep defense strong.
lessons.mistake: Falling into a pure ground vs ground fight without considering composition advantage, risking inefficiency.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have a strong army and economy. If opponent transitions to air, add anti-air or switch to air.
lessons.title: Maintain ground strength and tech for efficiency
lessons.when: Late-midgame, both have heavy ground armies (Zergling, Roach, Queen) with heavy production and moderate tech.
lessons.why: Adding Roaches gives durability, Hydralisks provide anti-air and damage. Heavy economy sustains a large army.
